Module com.batallanaval
Package com.batallanaval.view

Class Board3DView

java.lang.Object
com.batallanaval.view.Board3DView
All Implemented Interfaces:
BoardListener
public class Board3DView extends Object implements BoardListener
3D visual representation of a Board (replaces the 2D version, BoardView, which is left in the project unused). Each cell is a plate (Box) on the XZ plane; ships are groups of Box, Cylinder, and Sphere positioned and rotated in space; a PerspectiveCamera and a couple of lights (AmbientLight + PointLight) make them visible, following the same approach as the "Understanding 3D Shapes" chapter of Learn JavaFX 17. Everything lives inside a SubScene, which is a Node like any other and can therefore be inserted into the rest of the application's 2D layout (FXML) without changing anything else there. It registers as a BoardListener just like the 2D version, to automatically repaint the cell that changed without the model knowing anything about JavaFX (Observer). If this is the own (placement) board, it always shows the ships. If it is the opponent's board, ships stay hidden until they are hit/sunk, unless verification mode is turned on (HU-3).
